title: Anode-free sodium metal batteries: optimisation of electrolytes and interphases
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,3887-3916
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE00136F, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Huihua Li, Fanglin Wu, Jian Wang, Jingxuan Wang, Hongxu Qu, Minghua Chen, Huang Zhang, Stefano Passerini
The electrolyte and interphase chemistry plays a significant role in anode-free sodium metal batteries. Progresses in electrolyte optimization and interphase engineering are herein reviewed, focusing on their collective performance improvement.
